name: Ferienhaus Thaler
beschreibung:
Peacefully set in a sunny spot in the mountain village of Nesselwaengle, Ferienhaus Thaler welcomes guests with genuine Tyrolean hospitality. Its well-kept rooms and apartments provide all necessary comforts for an active yet restful getaway.

Located at the base of the Krinnenspitze and Rote Flueh, it is perfect for alpine hikes, climbing adventures, and direct winter access to valley cross-country ski trails.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhaus Thaler in Nesselwaengle offers welcoming family charm and alpine views at the gateway to the Tannheimer Tal.
